# RepMaths

> RepMaths is a free online collection of fitness calculators and gym tools for strength training, weightlifting, workout programming, barbell plate loading, sports nutrition, and body composition. Users can calculate fitness metrics, estimate lifting performance, plan training workloads, and understand common fitness and nutrition equations without creating an account.

RepMaths is designed for powerlifters, bodybuilders, athletes, strength trainees, gym users, and people interested in fitness and nutrition. Calculators run in the browser. Results are estimates for general fitness planning and education, not medical advice.

## Main Calculator Directory

- [All Fitness Calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/): Browse the complete collection of gym calculators, workout tools, strength calculators, and nutrition calculators.

## Calculator Categories

- [Strength Calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/): One-rep max, bench press, squat, deadlift, overhead press, rep max, and strength standards.
- [Training and Programming Calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/): Training max, 5/3/1 programming, warm-up sets, and RPE/RIR calculations.
- [Equipment Calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/equipment/): Barbell plate loading and weight setup.
- [Nutrition and Body Composition Calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/): Calories, TDEE, BMR, macros, protein, hydration, body fat, BMI, and body composition.

## Strength Calculators

- [1RM Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/1rm-calculator/): Estimate one-rep max using Epley, Brzycki, Lander, and Lombardi formulas, in lb or kg.
- [Bench Press Max Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/bench-press-1rm-calculator/): Estimate a bench press one-rep max from weight and repetitions.
- [Squat Max Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/squat-1rm-calculator/): Estimate a back squat one-rep max from weight and repetitions.
- [Deadlift Max Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/deadlift-1rm-calculator/): Estimate a deadlift one-rep max from weight and repetitions.
- [Overhead Press 1RM Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/overhead-press-1rm-calculator/): Estimate a strict overhead press one-rep max.
- [1RM Percentage Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/1rm-percentage-calculator/): Find the weight at any percentage of a one-rep max, or reverse-calculate a 1RM.
- [Rep Max Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/rep-max-calculator/): Convert a known weight and rep count to a target rep range.
- [Strength Standards Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/strength-standards-calculator/): Compare bench, squat, deadlift, and overhead press maxes against bodyweight-based reference standards.

## Training and Programming Calculators

- [Training Max Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/training-max-calculator/): Convert a one-rep max into a training max for percentage-based programs.
- [5/3/1 Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/531-calculator/): Generate working weights for the Wendler 5/3/1 four-week cycle.
- [Warm-Up Set Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/warmup-set-calculator/): Build a progressive warm-up ramp to a target working weight.
- [RPE & RIR Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/rpe-rir-calculator/): Estimate a one-rep max from a completed set using the RTS RPE chart.

## Equipment Calculators

- [Barbell Plate Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/equipment/plate-calculator/): Find the plates needed on each side of the bar for a target weight in lb or kg.

## Nutrition and Body Composition Calculators

- [TDEE Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/tdee-calculator/): Estimate maintenance calories using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and activity level.
- [BMR Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/bmr-calculator/): Estimate basal metabolic rate using Mifflin-St Jeor or Harris-Benedict.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/calorie-deficit-calculator/): Estimate a daily calorie target, deficit, and projected weight-loss timeline.
- [Macro Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/macro-calculator/): Convert daily calories into protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets for a goal.
- [Protein Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/protein-calculator/): Estimate daily protein intake in grams based on body weight and goal.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/water-intake-calculator/): Estimate daily water intake from body weight and activity.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/body-fat-calculator/): Estimate body fat percentage using the US Navy method or a BMI-based estimate.
- [BMI Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/bmi-calculator/): Calculate adult BMI and the healthy weight range for a given height.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Estimate lean body mass from body fat percentage or predictive equations.
- [FFMI Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/ffmi-calculator/): Calculate raw and normalized Fat-Free Mass Index.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/ideal-weight-calculator/): Compare ideal body weight estimates from Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi.
- [Calories Burned Calculator](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/calories-burned-calculator/): Estimate calories burned during activities using MET values.

## Calculation Methods and Methodology

RepMaths calculators use established equations and reference methods, including:

- One-rep max: Epley, Brzycki, Lander, and Lombardi formulas.
- Training programming: Wendler 5/3/1, training max percentages, and warm-up progressions.
- RPE and RIR: Reactive Training Systems (RTS) RPE chart.
- Basal metabolic rate: Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict equations.
- Body fat: US Navy tape measurement method.
- Protein intake: ISSN sports nutrition guidance.
- Calories burned: Metabolic Equivalent of Task (MET) values.
- Ideal body weight: Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi equations.

Calculator pages list the formula or reference method they use, where applicable. Refer to the relevant calculator page for details before relying on a result.

## Usage and Disclaimer

RepMaths provides estimates for informational and educational purposes. Results are not medical advice, diagnosis, or a substitute for professional fitness, nutrition, or healthcare guidance. Accuracy depends on the inputs, the selected method, and the assumptions. Consult a qualified professional before making significant training, dietary, or health decisions.
